Telangana Assembly Suspends Over 20 BRS MLAs During Monsoon Session

Over 20 Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) MLAs were suspended from the Telangana Assembly for the remainder of the monsoon session. The suspensions occurred amid disruptions caused by BRS members who thronged the Speaker's podium chanting "we want justice." The motion for suspension was moved by a minister.
